info.title: soroban-lens Query API
info.summary: Read-only HTTP API over indexed Soroban contract events.
info.description:
Serves events indexed from a Soroban RPC node. Read-only. Unauthenticated and unlimited by default; an operator can turn on per-IP rate limiting (`LENS_RATE_LIMIT_RPS`) and API keys (`LENS_API_KEYS`), in which case every route except `/health`, `/openapi.json` and `/docs` requires a key sent as `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer`, and a client over its limit receives `429` with `Retry-After`.

Pagination is keyset-based: pass the `nextCursor` from a response back as `cursor`. Pass the `prevCursor` back as `cursor` together with `direction=backward` to return to the previous page; paging forward and then back returns the original page exactly. Pages stay stable while the indexer writes new events behind them, which offset pagination cannot promise.

`GET /events` and `GET /contracts/{contractId}/events` carry an `ETag` derived from the newest indexed event id and the request's filter. Send it back as `If-None-Match` and an unchanged poll is answered with `304` and no body. `GET /events/stream` pushes new events as Server-Sent Events instead of polling.

Decoded integer values are JSON **strings**, not numbers. Soroban `i128`/`u128` amounts routinely exceed `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, so treating them as numbers loses precision on large transfers. Decoded `bytes` are lower-case hex strings.

Every route below also accepts `HEAD`, which returns the same status and headers as `GET` with an empty body — including the `Content-Length` the body would have had. The `head` operations are not listed separately.

Responses of 1KB or more are gzip- or deflate-compressed when the request's `Accept-Encoding` header allows it, with `Vary: Accept-Encoding` set so a cache in front of this API knows the body varies by that header. A request sending no `Accept-Encoding` — or `identity` — always gets uncompressed JSON.

Two features are **off by default** because they widen what the server does: `/graphql` (a query endpoint over the same data) and `/webhooks` (the server POSTs events to client-supplied URLs). Both answer `404` until an operator enables them; see the API README. When API keys are also enabled, send the key as `X-API-Key` so `Authorization: Bearer` stays free for the webhook token.

get.description: Performs a real write probe against the store, so a read-only volume or a full disk is reported here rather than surfacing later as an indexer failure. Returns 503 when the store is not writable or the schema is out of date.

503.description: Degraded — store unwritable or schema out of date

get.summary: Row counts and indexed ledger range

get.description: Statistics plus the saved cursor of every ingest stream, so a client can show indexer lag without querying the RPC node itself.

get.summary: List indexed contracts, most recently active first
List events emitted by one contract

200.description: A page of events, or with `format=csv` / `Accept: text/csv` a CSV stream of every matching event

schema.description: RFC 4180 CSV, streamed (chunked transfer, no Content-Length). Header row: id, contractId, type, ledger, ledgerClosedAt, txHash, transactionIndex, operationIndex, inSuccessfulContractCall, topic0..topicN, valueType, value, decodeError.

ETag.description: Weak validator derived from the newest indexed event id and this request's filter. Send it back as `If-None-Match`.

404.description: No event has ever been indexed for this contract id: it may not exist, or this instance may not index it.

get.description: Three situations used to look identical here. They no longer do: a contract this instance has never indexed an event for is `404`; a contract that is indexed but has no events matching the filters returns `200` with an empty `events` array and `emptyReason: "no_matching_events"`.

get.summary: Event counts per time bucket for one contract
get.description: Counts events per `minute`, `hour` or `day` of ledger close time, within the optional `from`/`to` range, oldest bucket first. Accepts the same repeatable `topic` prefix and `successfulOnly` filters as the events endpoint. Buckets with no events are omitted, so a client drawing a chart should fill the gaps with zero. Answers "how many events per hour this week" without paging every event.

get.summary: Event count, ledger range and last-seen time for one contract
get.description: The same summary GET /contracts returns for every contract, for a single one, so a caller does not have to fetch them all and filter client-side. Returns 404 when the contract has no indexed events.

404.description: No indexed events for this contract

get.summary: What typed decoding knows about a contract
get.description: Where the contract's spec came from — its own Wasm, or the built-in Stellar Asset Contract spec — and which SEP-48 events it declares. Events from a contract with a spec carry a `typed` view alongside the generic decoding. Returns 404 when no lookup has been made yet; a lookup that found nothing is a 200 with `source: "none"` and the reason in `error`.

404.description: No spec lookup has been made for this contract

get.summary: Distinct first-topic values for a contract
get.description: Ranked by frequency. Intended for building a filter UI without scanning every event. Topics that are themselves maps or vecs are not indexed and do not appear.

get.summary: List events across every indexed contract

200.description: A page of events, or with `format=csv` / `Accept: text/csv` a CSV stream of every matching event

schema.description: RFC 4180 CSV, streamed (chunked transfer, no Content-Length). Header row: id, contractId, type, ledger, ledgerClosedAt, txHash, transactionIndex, operationIndex, inSuccessfulContractCall, topic0..topicN, valueType, value, decodeError.

ETag.description: Weak validator derived from the newest indexed event id and this request's filter. Send it back as `If-None-Match`.

get.summary: Fetch one event by its RPC event id

get.description: Holds the connection open and writes each newly indexed event as it appears, as a `text/event-stream`. Takes the same filters as `GET /events` (plus `contractId`); `limit`, `order`, `cursor` and `direction` do not apply. Each message's `id` is the event id and its `data` is the event JSON, so a dropped connection resumes with `Last-Event-ID` instead of re-reading. Without it the stream starts at the present and carries only events indexed from now on. A comment line is sent every 15 seconds to keep idle connections open. Returns `503` when the instance already has its maximum number of streams open.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events. Each message is `id: <event id>` and `data: <event JSON>`, separated by a blank line.

get.description: Disabled by default (`404`); enable with `LENS_GRAPHQL=1`. Read-only: queries only. The schema covers `events`, `event`, `contracts`, `contract` and `topics`, with `Event.contract` joining an event to its contract summary. Documents are rejected before execution when deeper than `maxDepth` (default 8) or costlier than `maxComplexity` (default 5000). Introspection is not supported.

200.description: Result; resolver errors appear in `errors` alongside partial `data`.

400.description: The document failed to parse or validate, or exceeded the depth or complexity limits.

post.description: Matching events are POSTed as JSON `{ deliveryId, subscriptionId, event }` to `url`, in event order, starting with events indexed after registration. Each request carries `X-Lens-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" keyed with the secret>`, plus `X-Lens-Delivery` (stable across retries — de-duplicate on it), `X-Lens-Event-Id` and `X-Lens-Attempt`. A non-2xx answer or a network error is retried with exponential backoff (up to 5 attempts; 4xx other than 408/429 is not retried); after that the event is recorded as a dead letter. Redirects are not followed. Delivery attempts are rate limited per webhook and per target host, and targets must be public hosts. Webhooks and dead letters are held in memory and are lost when the API restarts.

201.description: Registered. The signing secret is shown only here.

get.description: Events that exhausted their retries, newest last; the most recent 100 are kept.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum rows to return. In a CSV export this caps the total rows written; without it every matching event is exported.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Keyset cursor — the `nextCursor` of a previous response (or, with `direction=backward`, its `prevCursor`).

Topic.name: topic
Topic.description: Topic prefix filter, positional and repeatable. `?topic=transfer` matches events whose first topic is `transfer`; `?topic=*&topic=order` matches events whose second topic is `order`. At most 4, because only the first four topic positions are indexed — note that events themselves may carry more than four topics.

FromLedger.name: fromLedger
FromLedger.description: Inclusive lower bound on ledger sequence.

ToLedger.name: toLedger
ToLedger.description: Inclusive upper bound on ledger sequence.

TxHash.name: txHash
TxHash.description: Only events emitted by this transaction.

SuccessfulOnly.name: successfulOnly
SuccessfulOnly.description: Exclude events from unsuccessful contract calls. Omitted returns both.

TransactionIndex.name: transactionIndex
TransactionIndex.description: Position of the transaction within its ledger. Combine with txHash to pin down one transaction's events exactly.

OperationIndex.name: operationIndex
OperationIndex.description: Position of the operation within its transaction.

FromTime.name: fromTime
FromTime.description: Inclusive lower bound on ledger close time. An ISO-8601 timestamp, or epoch seconds.

ToTime.name: toTime
ToTime.description: Inclusive upper bound on ledger close time. An ISO-8601 timestamp, or epoch seconds.

Ids.name: ids
Ids.description: Comma-separated event ids to resolve in one request, at most 100. Returns the matching events in the order asked plus a `missing` array of ids with no indexed event. Mutually exclusive with the filter parameters, which are ignored when this is present.

Address.name: address
Address.description: Match any event mentioning this address anywhere — a topic segment (indexed or beyond the 4-segment ceiling) or nested inside the decoded value. A StrKey: 'G' (account) or 'C' (contract) followed by 55 characters.

Search.name: search
Search.description: Substring match against a decoded event's topics and value, via a trigram full-text index. At least 3 characters — shorter terms match nothing, since trigram indexing works on 3-character runs.

Fields.name: fields
Fields.description: Comma-separated event properties to return, e.g. `id,ledger,topics,value`. Omit for every property (the default). `topicsXdr` and `valueXdr` roughly double the payload and are rarely read; leaving them out shrinks the response. Unknown names are rejected with 400.

ActivityBucket.name: bucket
ActivityBucket.description: Width of each time bucket, aligned to the epoch.

ActivityFrom.name: from
ActivityFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound on ledger close time. An ISO-8601 timestamp, or epoch seconds.

ActivityTo.name: to
ActivityTo.description: Inclusive upper bound on ledger close time. An ISO-8601 timestamp, or epoch seconds.

Format.name: format
Format.description: Response format. `csv` is equivalent to sending `Accept: text/csv` and wins over it; `json` is the default. CSV streams every matching event (see `limit`), one row per event, with `topic0..topicN` columns and the decoded value as JSON text, so large integers (`i128` and friends) stay quoted and keep their precision. Text-like topics starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` are prefixed with `'` so a spreadsheet does not run them as formulas.

Direction.name: direction
Direction.description: Which way to page from `cursor`. `forward` (the default) continues after it; `backward` returns the page immediately before it, still listed in `order`, so paging forward and then back returns the original page. `backward` with no `cursor` returns the last page.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: The `ETag` of a previous response. When nothing has been indexed since, the answer is `304` with no body.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: The `id` of the last event received. The stream resumes just after it, in order, instead of starting at the present. A browser `EventSource` sends this automatically when it reconnects.

LastEventIdQuery.name: lastEventId
LastEventIdQuery.description: Same as the `Last-Event-ID` header, for clients that cannot set headers.

StreamContractId.name: contractId
StreamContractId.description: Only stream events from this contract.

Unavailable.description: A schema migration is pending; the database is not at the version this build expects. Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. GET /health still answers and reports the reason.

Unauthorized.description: The instance requires an API key and none, or an invalid one, was sent, or `/webhooks` requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and it was missing or wrong. Only returned when the operator has configured `LENS_API_KEYS`.

TooManyRequests.description: The client has used up its rate-limit bucket. Only returned when the operator has configured `LENS_RATE_LIMIT_RPS`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before one request is available again.

TooManyWebhooks.description: The instance-wide or per-host webhook limit is reached

NotModified.description: The `If-None-Match` validator still matches, so nothing changed since the response it came from. No body.

DecodedValue.description: A decoded XDR ScVal. Integers are decimal strings and bytes are hex strings, so the payload is lossless under JSON.

type.description: ScVal arm, lower-cased. `undecodable` means the raw XDR could not be parsed; the `*Xdr` field still holds the original bytes.

id.description: RPC event id. Fixed width and sorts in ledger order.

inSuccessfulContractCall.description: False for events emitted by a contract call that later failed. Such events are still indexed.

topics.description: Full decoded topic list. May contain more than four entries — the four-segment limit applies to RPC filters, not to emitted events.

decodeError.description: Present only when decoding failed. The raw XDR fields remain valid.

TypedEvent.description: The event read through its contract's spec (SEP-48): a declared name and named, typed fields. Present only when the contract has a spec and the event matches one of its declared events; the generic `topics`/`value` decoding is always present regardless.

source.description: `wasm`: the contract's own spec. `stellar-asset`: the built-in Stellar Asset Contract spec (CAP-46-6, CAP-67).

type.description: Declared type, as written in the contract: `i128`, `Address`, `Option<u64>`, `Vec<Address>`, or a user-defined type's name.

location.description: Carried in a topic (indexed) or in the event data.

value.description: JSON-safe value, with the same conventions as DecodedValue: large integers are decimal strings, bytes are hex.

wasmHash.description: SHA-256 of the Wasm the spec was read from.

eventCount.description: Event declarations in the spec. Zero means no event will ever have a typed view — typically a contract built before soroban-sdk 23.

error.description: Why nothing usable was found, when `source` is `none`.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor`. Null on the last page.

prevCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` with `direction=backward` for the previous page. Null on the first page.

total.description: Rows matching the filter, ignoring limit and cursor.

totalIsEstimate.description: True when `total` came from a short-lived cache rather than a fresh COUNT(*) — accurate as of a couple of seconds ago, not necessarily this instant. Omitted entirely on an exact, freshly-computed count.

emptyReason.description: Present only on an empty page of `GET /contracts/{contractId}/events`: the contract is indexed, but nothing matches the filters.

key.description: Stream identifier, derived from RPC host and contract set.

network.description: Network this database was indexed from. 'unknown' when the indexer did not report one.

parameter.description: The offending query parameter, when one is identifiable.

requestId.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header and every structured log record for this request (#46) — quote it in a bug report to find the whole story server-side.

EventBatch.description: Returned when `ids` is supplied: the events that exist, plus the ids that did not.

WebhookFilter.description: All fields are ANDed. Same semantics as the matching query parameters of the event routes.

topics.description: Topic prefix; `null` is a wildcard for that position.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Loopback, private, link-local and reserved addresses, embedded credentials and other schemes are rejected.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Shown only in this response.

start.description: Bucket start (UTC); the bucket covers `[start, start + width)`.

count.description: Events whose ledger closed in this bucket.

firstLedger.description: Lowest ledger containing a matching event in this bucket.

lastLedger.description: Highest ledger containing a matching event in this bucket.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: An API key from the instance's `LENS_API_KEYS`. Only checked when the operator has configured keys; an instance without them accepts every request.

BearerAuth.description: The same API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
